request: Update the planner so that ALL run_command steps must be real executable commands. Specifically, remove any placeholder verification steps like 'command to generate a new plan'. If verification is needed, replace it with a real command (e.g., run the planner via its CLI or a Python entry point). If no valid command exists, skip the verification step instead of generating a placeholder.
title: Update planner to use real executable commands
goals: Identify all run_command steps in the planner that use placeholder verification steps
Replace placeholder verification steps with real executable commands

constraints: Do not generate any placeholder commands
Ensure all commands are executable via CLI or Python entry point
success_criteria: All run_command steps in the planner use real executable commands
No placeholder verification steps remain in the planner
